about_the_game:
The Benelux is fractured.

LOFU's (War machines developed by prestigious graphic designers and architects) — are cheap, weaponized, and everywhere. You’re a licensed pilot working for HEIZEN, a bounty agency that takes contracts from governments, corporations, and anyone else with enough money to make any problem disappear.

Split your time between talking to people, and taking on high-octane combat missions in the air. Investigate, track and eliminate rogue pilots, and possibly even find love. 

  • Hybrid gameplay: A seamless blend between investigation, social simulation and customizable mech combat in atmospheric rail-shooter encounters.

  • Non-linear progression: Choose which targets to pursue, which organizations to align with, and how deep to dig.

  • Abstract visuals: A stylized world inspired by the visuals of PC-98 and Sega Saturn games. 

  • Adapt yourself: Use the materials scavenged in missions to develop new parts and weapons, or gift these to a loved one.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains non-realistic violence against Mechs piloted by humans, including blood and a graphic image on kill. There is crude language, prostitution and sex is hinted towards, but never explicitly shown. Players can use several drugs and alcohol for differing (and sometimes positive) effects.
